semantics.source: External independently planned observation+fault schedule, compared with every ordered internal claim; neither file is authenticated service evidence.
semantics.accepted: Accepted synthetic SYS02 event; native metadata/prepared intent cannot become committed event.
semantics.durable: Separate modeled durable receipt; crash preserves durable intent.
semantics.commit: One declared transaction: state revision+request result+event application receipt+logical evidence consumption+checkpoint. No DB schema chosen.
semantics.retry: Same stream/event+same payload and original acceptance returns original receipt; same evidence new ID nonlearning; conflict errors.
semantics.publish: Only current epoch/revision+commit/checkpoint, no old scope/ref/source after invalidation.
semantics.costs: semantic_updates, durable_receipt_writes, application_receipt_writes, state_writes, consumption_writes, checkpoint_writes, db_transactions, db_flushes independently counted modeled operations; no measured DB cost.
semantics.state: Model event-chain commitment, not numeric DYN state or exact-once service proof. Fixed DYN canonical event/evidence identity reused unchanged.
semantics.presentation: display/return/packing/reader/use/outcome are distinct; a new explicit presentation cycle never inherits prior-cycle reader facts. Exclusion cannot generate same-cycle included reader evidence. Other paths assessed separately.
semantics.consumption_storage_slot: Exact DynamicsKeyV2 + unchanged frozen logical evidence identity; separate config versions cannot silently share state or consumption storage.

native_identity: No new native logical-evidence namespace proposed/selected. Native path unsupported for learning/durable commit until owner protocol selection; do not spoof synthetic_independent.
remaining: B real DB fault injection/migrations/native durable qualification

transaction_model.accept: Volatile validated admission only; durable responsibility begins at durable transaction. Crash loses admissions not durable.
transaction_model.durable: TxD durable event receipt; no state/consumption update.
transaction_model.commit: TxA state chain+event application receipt+request result+qualified consumption+checkpoint atomic. TxA db_flush=1 is declared schedule accounting, not measured physical flush.
transaction_model.recovery: TxD without TxA stays pending and worker retries. TxA reply-loss/crash returns exact first committed result.
transaction_model.storage_ADR: unselected; no DB table/record/migration/writer implementation supplied.

presentation_model.key: Exact dynamics key + event identity + explicit presentation_id + reader_id + primary/other path. Each presentation is a distinct observation cycle; no inheritance of earlier-cycle reader evidence.
presentation_model.limits: Declared fixture observations only. Reader receipt requires included pack on same reader/path; no outcome proof of use, no inference of actual reader receipt from server receipt. Current native pipeline has distinct receipt contracts and no universal event join.
presentation_model.repeat: A stage boolean is immutable within one cycle. Exact repeat is duplicate_stage_observation with no new fact; conflicting repeat is presentation_conflict. Earlier valid observations remain historical and are not erased.
presentation_model.payload_binding: Each cycle binds original payload SHA, accepted_seq and accepted_at_ns. Changed binding conflicts, including when presentation precedes modeled durable admission. Existing accepted-event conflict also has precedence over presentation. Outcome obeys the same immutable stage boolean rule but never proves use.

cost_counter_semantics.semantic_updates: Qualified first logical evidence applications, even if selected zero numeric coefficient; not numerical changed-row count.
cost_counter_semantics.state_writes: Accepted unique event-chain/revision writes, including nonlearning; numeric scalar contents not computed.
cost_counter_semantics.application_receipt_writes: Unique modeled TxA event application records.
cost_counter_semantics.db_transactions: Declared TxD+TxA commits, excludes rejected/CAS/crash attempts; not actual DB measurements.
cost_counter_semantics.db_flushes: Declared one flush per successful modeled transaction, no physical durability guarantee.
cost_counter_semantics.request_writes: One retained request result per first TxA commit.
cost_counter_semantics.db_writes: Declared record writes: TxD durable + TxA state/application receipt/request/checkpoint plus first consumption; not measured physical write amplification.

source_inventory.observation: Packing/final source/ref/run fence then context_usage receipt+audit in native Tx; server_return only.
context_usage jobs record; RecentMemoryUsage measurement server_return and actual_use not_measured.
Pinned injection has independent usage receipt path; primary packing exclusion says nothing about it.
evaluation outcome+audit transaction, API retry/current refs; absent native task/trial/processing sequence.
Derived signals persisted in jobs; aggregate context_usage not reader-use proof.
Separate source_read/briefing/summary_handoff/turn_input metadata, not universal future information-path proof.
Briefing/summary path can retain context beyond immediate retrieval.
Persisted usage receipt dependencies included in erasure lookup.

support_ledger.relation: partial: current known persistent paths inventoried and stage separation modeled; no implementation of paper algorithm or all-future-path sufficiency proof.
A model/fixture only; B actual commit/fault/migration/service remains unsupported.

command_primitives.request_id: nonempty Unicode scalar UTF8<=256bytes no controls
command_primitives.event_index: JSON integer0..MaxInt64 and < observation count, bool/float forbidden
command_primitives.writer_epoch: JSON integer0..MaxInt64; model-only local worker generation
command_primitives.expected_revision: JSON integer0..MaxInt64, compare to exact key revision
command_primitives.checkpoint_seq: JSON integer0..MaxInt64; accepted processing order, not timestamp
command_primitives.included: JSON boolean; no server-return inference of use
command_primitives.presentation_id: Required bounded nonempty identifier; separate presentation cycle identity, not request id or authorization. Used only by presentation stages.

claim_validation: Every key required, no extra; exact JSON-semantic typed equality to independently supplied external source schedule replay. bool not int; fixed DYN/SYS validators validate original full observation/key/ref/clock.
